component.name: Gozar
component.summary: Connect to the Firefox Private Network

description.p: Gozar signs in to the Firefox Private Network, lists the available endpoints, and keeps the system behind the tunnel it selects.

The tunnel runs on the host through polkit, because creating a network interface and changing the routing table needs administrator rights that the sandbox does not have. Gozar asks for that password once per session through your desktop's authentication dialog.
